subject: School Committee Campaign Platform
overview: Candidate Lisa Kingsley discussed her platform for the Medford School Committee, emphasizing the need for a clear instructional vision to guide district spending and resource decisions.

items.title: Clear Vision for Learning Coffee Chat
items.summary: Candidate Lisa Kingsley, joined by her daughter Annie, outlined her campaign platform for the Medford School Committee, arguing that a clear and shared district-wide vision for instruction is essential for making effective budget, curriculum, and staffing decisions.
